description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter named TopNavAdapter for a top navigation bar in an Android TV app. It manages a list of category names, including a special search item, providing focusability and visual feedback suitable for TV navigation. The adapter creates view holders, binds data, and handles focus and click events.

classes.name: TopNavAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying top navigation categories with focus handling.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the adapter with a list of items and an onClick callback, and submits the list.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to a ViewHolder for a given position.

properties.name: SEARCH_ITEM
properties.description: A constant string token representing the search icon item.

classes.name: TopNavVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class managing individual navigation tab views.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Configures the view elements based on whether the item is a search icon or a label, and sets focus and click behavior.

methods.name: DiffUtil.ItemCallback
methods.description: Provides custom diffing logic for list updates.
